evidence_plan.requirement: methods used to reduce data sparsity effects

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address data sparsity in NMT systems.

claims.text: Advanced methods were combined to reduce the adverse impacts of data sparsity in NMT systems.
Data augmentation methods, such as the mix-source method, were employed to alleviate data sparsity issues.
Techniques to increase training data were described to help NMT systems cope with low-resourced situations.
